Ravi (Eng): Heads up - I'm leaving next Thursday. Quick Q: can I move my 401k after my exit or do I need to do anything before then?
Maya (People Ops): Congrats on the new role! :tada: You can elect a rollover after separation. Two things: outstanding loans, and whether Guideline needs the termination confirmed to show options.
Ravi (Eng): I have a $4.2k loan outstanding. Will that block a rollover?
Maya (People Ops): If unpaid, many plans treat loan balance as a deemed distribution (taxable). Guideline often offsets the loan against your balance, reducing rollover amount.
Ravi (Eng): Can payroll deduct the loan from my final pay?
Kali (Payroll): Yes we can do a one-time deduction if you notify us before final payroll cutoff. Send amount + written ok (DM or email).
Ravi (Eng): Final payroll cutoff is in 36h. What's the vendor portal?
Maya (People Ops): We're on Guideline: https://login.guideline.com/companies/redwood-inference. We'll notify them of your termination date so they send the election email.
Ravi (Eng): If Guideline sends me a check, any tax withholding?
Kali (Payroll): If it's a distribution sent to you, federal withholding of 20% usually applies. Direct trustee-to-trustee rollovers avoid withholding.
Ravi (Eng): Any impact from vesting? I had an equity cliff but not sure about match vesting.
Maya (People Ops): Only vested contributions are eligible to rollover. Check "Plan Documents" in Guideline for your vesting schedule. We'll confirm vested balance with Guideline on your separation date.
PlanBot: [system] Reminder: vendor processing times typically 7-14 business days after election received.
Ravi (Eng): I'll DM Kali with deduction amount now. Thanks for the quick help.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks Ravi, we'll post confirmation here once payroll and Guideline updates are complete. Good luck! :rocket:
